posts.title: About
posts.description: I'm Carl. I build Starseer, an AI security platform that looks inside models instead of just watching what they output. Before that I did vulnerability research at Cisco Talos, uncovering and addressing vulnerabilities across a spectrum of systems. Basilisk Labs is my personal brand, named after the mythological king of serpents. This blog lives under it. When I am not shipping code or hunting CVEs, I am building things that move. I have built three Voron printers from scratch. A Trident, a V0, and a Switchwire. I spend an unreasonable amount of time chasing resonance artifacts, dialing in toolheads, and printing parts I absolutely did not need. This blog is where I write about infrastructure, AI security, reverse engineering, Rust, Kubernetes, and whatever else breaks or fascinates me this week. Find me on GitHub .
